name: call
description: Represents a phone call or voice call action. On hover, the handset vibrates with a decaying rotational jitter (±10° → 0°) and horizontal buzz, simulating the physical sensation of an incoming ring.

animation.description: Decaying rotational jitter (0°→-10°→9°→...→0°) with proportional horizontal buzz (0→±0.6px→0) looping continuously while hovered. Snaps to rest on hover-leave. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as an action button, the parent should clarify who is being called (e.g. aria-label='Call Jane Doe').
